bends.note: start of the curve: nearly straight SSE from Hopple to here
on the curve toward SE; leaves the sheet at the right margin past Rawson

ends.note: west end at the bank of Mill Creek

notes: HOPPLE, JOHNSON, RAWSON and TOWNSHIP are printed without suffix and written with 'Street'. Mostly the Cincinnati Union Stock Yards and railroad tracks (ignored); Hopple crosses the tracks at grade and Township passes under them through a 'stone arched driveway under R.R.'. Johnson (~28 ft, no width printed) only shows as a stub from sheet 304 and ends at Hopple. Spring Grove Av turns at Hopple from nearly N-S (north of Hopple) to SSE, then curves to SE and leaves the right margin; Rawson starts from its south side. Rawson's east line is at x~6405, just inside the binding, so its centre (x~6288) is on the paper. Township continues east of Rawson (block corner on the east side) into the binding. The left part of the sheet is lots south of Hopple (block 1) with no other streets; the tracks on the iron bridge over Mill Creek are ignored.
